import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

+      e.update(dt, this)
+      if (e.dead || e.dying || this.won || this.player.dead) continue
+      const overlap =

+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  addCoin(n) {
+    const before = this.coinsCount
+    this.coinsCount += n
+    if (Math.floor(this.coinsCount / 50) > Math.floor(before / 50)) {
+      this.lives++
+      this.addText(this.player.x + this.player.w / 2, this.player.y - 18, '¡VIDA EXTRA!', '#8fe76b')

+
+  checkHazards() {
+    const x0 = Math.floor(this.player.x / TILE)

+    const y0 = Math.floor(this.player.y / TILE)

+    for (let ty = y0; ty <= y1; ty++) {
+      for (let tx = x0; tx <= x1; tx++) {
+        if (this.getTile(tx, ty) === T.SPIKE) {
+          this.player.hit(this)
+          return
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  checkCheckpoints() {
+    for (const cp of this.checkpoints) {
+      if (cp.active) continue
+      if (Math.abs(this.player.x + this.player.w / 2 - cp.x) < 12) {

+  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

+
+  drawBackground(ctx) {

+    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, VIEW_H)

+    sky.addColorStop(0.55, '#9adcef')
+    sky.addColorStop(1, '#d6f4e6')
+    ctx.fillStyle = sky
+    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VIEW_W, VIEW_H)
+
+    // Sol
+    const sunX = 392 - cam * 0.02
+    const sunY = 46
+    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 4, sunX, sunY, 46)
+    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,246,196,.95)')
+    glow.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255,240,170,.35)')
+    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,170,0)')
+    ctx.fillStyle = glow
+    ctx.fillRect(sunX - 46, sunY - 46, 92, 92)
+    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff3b0'
+    ctx.beginPath()
+    ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2)
+    ctx.fill()

+    for (const c of this.clouds) {
+      const art = this.art.cloud[c.s]
+      const span = 1500
+      let x = (c.x - cam * c.p) % span
+      if (x < -120) x += span
+      ctx.globalAlpha = c.a
+      ctx.drawImage(art, Math.round(x), Math.round(c.y))
+    }
+    ctx.globalAlpha = 1

+    // Colinas lejanas
+    this.drawHills(ctx, cam * 0.16, 246, 150, 60, '#9fdcb8')
+    this.drawHills(ctx, cam * 0.34, 248, 190, 74, '#77cc98')
+    this.drawHills(ctx, cam * 0.58, 250, 240, 88, '#59b87c')

+    for (let i = -1; i < 4; i++) {
+      const bx = i * bushSpan - ((cam * 0.78) % bushSpan) + 30
+      const size = i % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 1
+      ctx.drawImage(this.art.bush[size], Math.round(bx), 240 - this.art.bush[size].height + 3)
+    }

+    // Franja de suelo lejana para dar profundidad
+    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(34,92,57,.22)'
+    ctx.fillRect(0, 240, VIEW_W, VIEW_H - 240)
+  }
+
+  drawHills(ctx, offset, baseY, width, height, color) {
+    const span = width * 0.9
+    const start = -((offset % span) + span) % span
+    ctx.fillStyle = color
+    for (let i = -1; i < 5; i++) {
+      const x = start + i * span
+      ctx.beginPath()
+      ctx.ellipse(x + width / 2, baseY, width / 2, height, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2)

+      const x = start + i * span

+      ctx.ellipse(x + width / 2 - 18, baseY - 8, width / 3, height * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.55)
+      ctx.fill()
+    }
+  }
+
+  drawTiles(ctx) {
+    const startX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(this.camera.x / TILE) - 1)
+    const endX = Math.min(239, startX + 32)
+    for (let tx = startX; tx <= endX; tx++) {

+        const t = this.getTile(tx, ty)
+        if (t === T.EMPTY || t === T.PIPE_BODY) continue

+        const y = ty * TILE
+        if (t === T.GROUND) {

+        if (t === T.PIPE_TOP) {
+          if (this.getTile(tx - 1, ty) === T.PIPE_TOP || this.getTile(tx - 1, ty) === T.PIPE_BODY) continue
+          let h = 1
+          while (this.getTile(tx, ty + h) === T.PIPE_BODY) h++
+          ctx.drawImage(this.art.pipe(h), x - 2, y)
+          continue
+        }
+        if (t === T.BRICK) {
+          this.drawBumped(ctx, tx, ty, this.art.brick)

+        }
+        if (t === T.QUESTION) {

+          continue

+        if (t === T.USED) {
+          this.drawBumped(ctx, tx, ty, this.art.used)
+          continue
+        }
+        if (t === T.PLATFORM) {
+          ctx.drawImage(this.art.platform, x, y)
+          continue
+        }
+        if (t === T.SPIKE) {
+          ctx.drawImage(this.art.spike, x, y)
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  drawBumped(ctx, tx, ty, image) {

+
+  drawFlower(ctx, x, y, tx) {

+    ctx.fillStyle = '#3f8f3c'
+    ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y - 2, 1, 3)

+    if (variant === 0) {
+      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff4d6'
+      ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y - 3, 1, 1)
+    }
+  }
+
+  drawPlatforms(ctx) {
+    for (const p of this.platforms) {
+      const x = Math.round(p.x)
+      const y = Math.round(p.y)

+  drawCoins(ctx) {
+    for (const coin of this.coins) {

+      const frame = Math.floor(this.time * 10 + coin.phase) % 4
+      const bob = Math.sin(this.time * 3 + coin.phase) * 1.5

+  drawPowerups(ctx) {

+  }

+  drawPlayer(ctx, p) {

+  drawEnemy(ctx, e) {

+  drawCheckpoints(ctx) {

+  drawCastle(ctx) {

+  }
+
+  drawParticles(ctx) {
+    for (const p of this.particles) {

+  drawTexts(ctx) {

drawCheckpoints(ctx) {
    for (const cp of this.checkpoints) {
      const x = Math.round(cp.x)
      const baseY = GROUND_ROW * TILE
      // Base de piedra
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5f6b78'
      ctx.fillRect(x - 6, baseY - 5, 12, 5)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8b95a3'
      ctx.fillRect(x - 6, baseY - 5, 12, 2)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#414d59'
      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, baseY - 38, 4, 34)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb0bd'
      ctx.fillRect(x - 2, baseY - 38, 1, 34)

      if (cp.active) {
        const glow = 0.5 + Math.sin(this.time * 4) * 0.2
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,216,115,${glow * 0.28})`
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.arc(x, baseY - 40, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2)
        ctx.fill()
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = cp.active ? '#ffd873' : '#9aa7b0'
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(x, baseY - 40, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2)
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.fillStyle = cp.active ? '#fff6c9' : '#c3ced6'
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(x - 1, baseY - 41.5, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2)
      ctx.fill()

      ctx.fillStyle = cp.active ? '#57b84c' : '#7f8c99'
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(x + 2, flagTop)
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 12, flagTop + 2 + wave, x + 22, flagTop + 4 + wave)
      ctx.lineTo(x + 22, flagTop + 13 + wave)
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 12, flagTop + 11 + wave, x + 2, flagTop + 9)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.fillStyle = cp.active ? '#8fe76b' : '#9aa7b0'
      ctx.fillRect(x + 2, flagTop + 1, 18, 1)

      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(x + 12, flagTop + 6.5 + wave * 0.6, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2)

  }

## Objective
- Build a 2D Mario-style platformer game featuring a frog-man protagonist ("Sapo Bros") in the user's PlayGround repo.

## Requirements
- User request: "Un juego 2D, personaje un hombre sapo con obstáculos como Mario Bros".
- Must run as a static web app served from `index.html` (no build step).
- Mobile support with touch controls and responsive layout.

## Decisions
- Built with vanilla JS ES modules + Canvas 2D; all art/audio generated procedurally (no external assets).
- Internal resolution 480x272, 16px tiles, 17 rows, 240 columns, fixed 1/60 timestep.
- Player abilities: run (Shift/B), variable jump, coyote time, jump buffer, stomp enemies, shield bubble power-up, checkpoints, 3 lives, 300s timer, score/best score in localStorage.
- Created full level with pipes, bricks, ? blocks, coins, spikes, pits with water, moving platforms, 3 enemy types (grumo/goomba, salto/hopper frog, mosca/fly), 2 checkpoints, goal flag and castle.
- Spanish UI (title, HUD, pause, game over, victory); procedural chiptune music/sfx via WebAudio.
- Portrait mode: game at top, touch buttons fixed at viewport bottom; landscape: touch buttons overlay bottom corners; top-right icon buttons below HUD.

## Work State
### Completed
- `js/level.js`: full level layout builder, tile types, entities, checkpoints, moving platforms, goal/castle positions (240x17 tiles, spawn x=7*16, goalX=230*16+8).
- `js/art.js`: frog pixel sprites (idle/walkA/walkB/jump), enemy sprites, tiles (ground, dirt, brick, question, used, platform, spike, pipe), coins, clouds, bushes.
- `js/audio.js`: synthesized sfx + looping chiptune music, mute toggle persisted.
- `js/game.js`: Game class with player/enemy physics, tile/one-way platform collisions, block bumping, coin/powerup pickups, checkpoints, death/respawn, victory, particles/texts/screen shake, camera, full renderer (sky, parallax hills, clouds, water pits, castle, goal flag, HUD integration).
- `js/main.js`: UI wiring, keyboard/touch input, pause/blur handling, fullscreen/sound buttons, rAF loop.
- `index.html`, `css/style.css`: complete UI, overlays, responsive/mobile layouts, safe-area handling.
- Verified via `playwright-cli` screenshots: title, gameplay, section C/D/E/F, goal/victory, game over, pause, mobile portrait + landscape, shield power-up, checkpoint, stomp (+200), block bump (?→USED, powerup spawns/collects), moving platform carry, checkpoint respawn.
- Game server runs on `PORT=3002`; all visual checks pass with no current console errors.

### Active
- Final polish/verification after last jump-height buff (`-465`) and enemy spike-avoidance change.
- Last screenshot `screenshots/shield.png` confirmed shield bubble renders correctly.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove debug hooks: `window.__sapo = game` in `js/main.js`; `deathLog` push in `killPlayer()` and `this.deathLog = []` in `resetWorld()` in `js/game.js`.
2. Update `README.md` with game title, description, controls (keyboard + touch), and how to run; preserve the existing OMGithub generated block.
3. Final reload/verification: desktop title + gameplay + mobile touch screenshot, confirm zero console errors.
4. Optionally stop the local server started in background on port 3002.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game shell, HUD, overlays, touch controls markup.
- `css/style.css`: all styling, responsive/portrait/touch rules.
- `js/game.js`: core game logic + renderer (largest file); contains debug `deathLog` to remove.
- `js/level.js`: level design data; recent changes to spawn, platforms, bricks row 11.
- `js/art.js`: procedural sprites/tiles; recent spike redesign.
- `js/audio.js`: WebAudio sfx/music.
- `js/main.js`: UI/input bootstrap; contains `window.__sapo` debug to remove.
- `README.md`: still needs game documentation update.
- `screenshots/`: verification captures (gitignored).

## Important Context
- `start.sh` uses `RUNTIME_DIR` scripts; project is detected as static HTML (`index.html`), served on `PORT` (used 3002 for tests).
- `playwright-cli` required `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` first; screenshots captured via `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=...`.
- Key constants: gravity 1500, jump velocity -465 (~79px jump height), max walk 156, max run 246, player hitbox 10x20, sprite 16x20.
- Touch input buttons use `.tbtn[data-key]` with PointerEvents; keyboard names must use `ArrowRight`, `Space`, etc.
- HUD only visible when `#frame` has `.playing`; touch controls hidden when not `.playing`.
- Level gaps at tiles 33-36, 57-61, 88-92, 120-124, 158-161, 190-194; checkpoints at tiles 96 and 186.
- `powerBlocks` is a `Set` of tile indices in the level; `hitBlock()` checks `ty * COLS + tx`.
- Victory triggers when `player.x + player.w >= goalX - 4`; time bonus = `ceil(timeLeft) * 10` + 1000.

# 🐸 Sapo Bros · Aventura Anfibia

Un juego de plataformas 2D con un hombre sapo como protagonista y obstáculos al estilo Mario Bros. Corre, salta, aplasta bichos, rompe bloques, recoge monedas y llega a la bandera del pantano.

Todo el arte, la música y los efectos de sonido se generan de forma procedural: no hay imágenes ni audio externos. Es una web app estática (HTML + Canvas 2D + módulos ES), sin build step.

## 🎮 Cómo jugar

| Acción | Teclado | Táctil |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Moverte | `←` `→` o `A` `D` | Botones ◀ ▶ |
| Saltar (altura variable) | `Espacio`, `Z` o `↑` | Botón **A** |
| Correr | `Shift` | Botón **B** |
| Pausa | `P` o `Esc` | Icono ⏸ |
| Silenciar | `M` | Icono ♪ |

- Mantén el salto pulsado para llegar más alto y suéltalo antes para un salto corto.
- Salta sobre los enemigos para aplastarlos. Los erizos y pinchos no se pueden pisar.
- Golpea los bloques **?** desde abajo para conseguir monedas o el escudo.
- El escudo absorbe un golpe y te protege de un enemigo o de caer a una zona peligrosa.
- Hay dos checkpoints: si pierdes una vida, reapareces en el último alcanzado conservando el tiempo.
- Tienes 3 vidas y 300 segundos. Al llegar a la bandera, el tiempo restante se convierte en puntos extra.
- Tu récord se guarda en `localStorage`.

## 🚀 Ejecutar en local

El proyecto usa módulos ES, así que necesita servirse por HTTP (abrir `index.html` directamente no funciona en la mayoría de navegadores).

```bash
# Opción 1: Python
python3 -m http.server 8080

# Opción 2: Node
npx serve .
```

Después abre <http://localhost:8080>. En el entorno de OMGithub, el proyecto se detecta como HTML estático y se sirve automáticamente con `start.sh`.

## 🕹️ Móvil

La interfaz es responsive. En vertical el juego queda arriba y los controles táctiles fijos abajo; en horizontal los botones se superponen en las esquinas inferiores. Incluye botón de pantalla completa y respeta las áreas seguras de los dispositivos con notch.

## 🧱 Estructura

```
index.html      Estructura de la UI, HUD y overlays
css/style.css   Estilos, layouts responsive y controles táctiles
js/main.js      Arranque, input de teclado/táctil y pantallas
js/game.js      Física, colisiones, enemigos, cámara y renderizado
js/level.js     Diseño del nivel, tiles y entidades
js/art.js       Sprites y tiles dibujados de forma procedural
js/audio.js     Música chiptune y efectos con WebAudio
```

+```bash
+# Opción 1: Python
+python3 -m http.server 8080
+
+# Opción 2: Node
+npx serve .
+```
+
+Después abre <http://localhost:8080>. En el entorno de OMGithub, el proyecto se detecta como HTML estático y se sirve automáticamente con `start.sh`.
+
+## 🕹️ Móvil
+
+La interfaz es responsive. En vertical el juego queda arriba y los controles táctiles fijos abajo; en horizontal los botones se superponen en las esquinas inferiores. Incluye botón de pantalla completa y respeta las áreas seguras de los dispositivos con notch.
+
+## 🧱 Estructura
+
+```
+index.html      Estructura de la UI, HUD y overlays
+css/style.css   Estilos, layouts responsive y controles táctiles
+js/main.js      Arranque, input de teclado/táctil y pantallas
+js/game.js      Física, colisiones, enemigos, cámara y renderizado
+js/level.js     Diseño del nivel, tiles y entidades
+js/art.js       Sprites y tiles dibujados de forma procedural
+js/audio.js     Música chiptune y efectos con WebAudio
+```
